promotion_rule: On active closure, first re-rank remaining items using the new evidence. Then promote the highest-value unblocked item; do not blindly increment the numeric ID if the dependency picture changed.
guard: The queue organizes research; it does not grant permission to invent thresholds, upgrade provenance from outcomes, or treat historical proxy results as canonical rules.
reopen_rule: Create/reopen a bounded research item only when new source evidence, new labeled examples, a frozen execution specification, or a genuinely untouched holdout materially resolves a named blocker.
